data.name: Jayadeep
data.gender_notes: Jayadeep is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jaya (Victory) + Deep (Deep, Ocean): This name signifies the victory over deep or profound aspects of life. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a sage who attained enlightenment after a long period of deep meditation. The name Jayadeep carries the meaning “Victory over deep” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jayadeep usually hope their child will grow to embody victory over deep and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength, wisdom, and the ability to overcome challenges.
data.etymology: Jayadeep belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory over deep.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jayadeep total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: Jayadeep was a famous king of the Chalukya Dynasty in the Deccan region of India during the 11th century. He is known for his military conquests and cultural patronage.
historical_references.context: The Chalukya Empire was a major power in medieval India, ruling over large parts of present-day South India.

historical_references.reference: Jayadeep is also known as Jayasimha II or Jayasimha Siddharaja, and he is considered one of the greatest rulers in Chalukyan history. He expanded the empire's territory, built temples and reservoirs, and established a strong administration.
historical_references.context: During his reign, the Chalukya Empire reached its zenith under Jayadeep's rule, making him a significant figure in Indian history.
